slides.say: In React nineteen, a form’s action prop can be a function.
React calls it with a FormData object holding every input with a name. No value and on change pairs, no on submit, no prevent default.

slides.text: React runs it in a Transition, exposes pending via useFormStatus, sends errors to an Error Boundary.
slides.say: React runs the function in a Transition, makes the pending state available to children, and sends errors to the nearest Error Boundary.

slides.text: On success, uncontrolled fields are reset.
slides.say: And when it succeeds, React resets the form’s uncontrolled fields.
